scope: Per one-step selection call; counts describe software work, not equivalent CPU cost or quantum gates
null: Operation applicable to the historical literal but not recorded; unavailable rather than zero
zero: Known nonapplicable operation under the explicit contract
fitness_evaluations: Candidate masks scored in swarm including empty-invalid masks; singleton scores scanned in exact/systematic baselines
candidate_distance_evaluations: Euclidean distances from all eligible candidate particles to the shared noisy centre
summary_distance_evaluations: Additional Euclidean distances from the distinct returned particles, computed by result summarization
measurement_mask_samples: Observed swarm masks; one per swarm row per executed generation
measurement_binary_entries: Bernoulli comparisons q<u; population x eligible dimensions x executed generations
probability_initialization_entries: Initial uniform q entries; population x eligible dimensions
probability_update_entries: q entries updated; population x dimensions x actually executed update steps
personal_best_score_comparisons: Scores compared to personal best; population per generation
personal_best_replacements: Personal mask rows actually replaced; counts rows rather than bits
global_argmax_input_scores: Number of scores supplied to argmax; does not assert exact library comparison count
global_best_score_comparisons: Winner scores compared to retained global score; one per generation
global_best_replacements: Global mask replacements on strict fitness improvement
duplication_output_indices: Number of output particle indices constructed by cyclic duplication
resampling_output_indices: Number of returned indices from systematic sampling; duplication is counted separately
likelihood_evaluations: Gaussian observation likelihood calls, absent from this same-fitness selection module
rotation_events: Absent; q-linear mapping is not counted as a quantum rotation
oracle_calls: Absent; no oracle supplied to EC selection
overlap: Measurement binary entries equals the legacy binary_dimensions_processed; do not sum these duplicate measures into a total work number
runtime: Descriptive initialization-inclusive operator wall time; historical timings are retained only as provenance and are not ranked against new execution
